description: This Java class `SearchSuggestionSampleProvider` extends `SearchRecentSuggestionsProvider` to implement a search suggestions provider with a specific authority and operating mode, used for providing search suggestions based on recent queries within an Android application.

classes.name: SearchSuggestionSampleProvider
classes.description: A subclass of `SearchRecentSuggestionsProvider` that sets up a suggestions provider with a specific authority and mode.

methods.name: SearchSuggestionSampleProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the suggestions provider with the specified authority and mode by calling `setupSuggestions`.
